page.overview:
Who is Trypto Buball?

Trypto Buball was an alien male agricultural baron who grew wealthy due to the vast space-fungi farming colonies that his family owned. he was a guest at the Canto Casino and Racetrack in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica and was standing near a row of gaming machines when fellow patron Dobbu Scay mistook the astromech droid BB-8 for one of the devices.

Buball was later standing in the casino crowds near BB-8's companions Finn and Rose Tico when the pair spotted the gambler known as the Master Codebreaker. While at the casino, the baron wore a black suit with a white trim along with black boots, white chaps, and a white padded collar. He used a dark blue and silver cane to walk and had dark pink skin, yellow eyes, and a gray mustache.

Trypto Buball first appeared in the sequel trilogy film Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi, Concept art of the character was created by Jake Lunt Davies and during production Buball was known as "Turkey Guy." The character was portrayed by Aidan Cook and unused B-roll footage of Buball shows him on other parts of the casino floor, including a close-up of the alien looking over the shoulder of a human casino guest. The character was first identified in the reference book Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary, which was written by Pablo Hidalgo
